pages.text: Cobaltite is a cobalt arsenide-sulfide from the silver-cobalt veins in calcite. Roast it on a campfire or in a smoker to drive off the arsenic and sulfur, then blast the roasted ore to the metal. Four cobalt and a samarium make SmCo; two cobalt, four nickel and a rhenium make the superalloy.
pages.title: Cobalt

pages.text: Roasted cobaltite calcined with two bauxite powder is cobalt blue, four blue dye.
